findings.title: Diagnostic free memory assumes 4 KiB pages
findings.reproduction: Collect 65536 free pages of 16384 bytes: the diagnostic reports 0.2 GB instead of 1.0 GB.
findings.root_cause: Free pages are multiplied by a literal 4096 rather than the native page size.
findings.silent_failure: Previous tests did not assert calculated memory values.
findings.regression_test: Replay native snapshots with 4 KiB and 16 KiB pages, zero free pages and missing page size.

findings.title: Diagnostic Retina scale depends on Dock width
findings.reproduction: Collect a 2x display with equal usable and full widths: the diagnostic reports 1.0x.
findings.root_cause: Both desktop rectangles use points; their ratio is not native display scaling.
findings.silent_failure: Previous tests asserted collector availability rather than scale values.
findings.regression_test: Vary native mode scale independently from usable desktop width.

findings.title: Retired system-load samples append after keylogger stop
findings.reproduction: Start a top sample, stop or pause the keylogger, then deliver the saved completion callback.
findings.root_cause: The task completion bypasses the hardware generation and enable/pause guard.
findings.silent_failure: The log-manager event queue accepts stale callbacks without another lifecycle check.
findings.regression_test: Reject completions after pause, disable, stop and restart while delivering a current-generation sample.

findings.title: Control bytes invalidate download error JavaScript
findings.reproduction: Pass a CRLF PTY error tail to set_error; the retained CR appears raw in a JavaScript string literal.
findings.root_cause: The shared local string encoder escapes quotes and backslashes but not control bytes.
findings.silent_failure: JavaScript evaluation rejects the call without displaying the install failure; prior tests covered only quotes and backslashes.
findings.regression_test: Check escaped payloads for error, step, detail and log methods with CRLF, tab, NUL, escape, quotes and backslashes.

findings.title: Retired download-window callbacks cancel successor operations
findings.reproduction: Show A, retain its close callback, hide A, show B, then invoke A's callback; B is canceled and its native owner cleared.
findings.root_cause: Native callbacks read mutable singleton ownership, and paired controller callbacks reread globals after reentrant calls.
findings.silent_failure: Native closure and bridge tests do not deliver predecessor callbacks after a successor is published.
findings.regression_test: Deliver stale close/navigation/readiness and bridge callbacks, including same-window reuse and reentrant abort/retry controllers; successor ownership and callbacks must remain untouched.

findings.title: Escaped input-source names cannot be selected correctly
findings.reproduction: Parse the Python probe output ["Fran\u00e7ais"] with current layout Français: the record retains literal escapes and is not selected.
findings.root_cause: The parser extracts quoted substrings instead of decoding the Python probe's JSON array.
findings.silent_failure: Existing vectors contain ASCII names without JSON escapes; malformed names flow into native layout selection.
findings.regression_test: Replay Unicode, quote and backslash escapes through the real parser and reject malformed or non-string arrays.

findings.title: Delayed replacement dispatch exhausts the paste settle fence
findings.reproduction: Prepare with 0.2 s dispatch budget and 0.1 s settling, fire the fence at 0.3 s, then complete the replacement at 1 s: terminator replay activates immediately at 1 s.
findings.root_cause: The fence is anchored to preparation and a nominal budget rather than actual replacement completion.
findings.silent_failure: Nominal timing tests do not delay actual replacement completion beyond the precomputed fence deadline.
findings.regression_test: Delay completion beyond the budget and require the full settle interval afterward while preserving admission-before-consumption timer ownership.

findings.title: Failed sensor commands persist empty system-load measurements
findings.reproduction: Complete an enabled system-load task with exit status 1 and empty stdout: one empty system_load event is persisted without an error log.
findings.root_cause: The completion ignores process exit status and does not validate parsed metrics before persistence.
findings.silent_failure: An empty event is indistinguishable from a successful sample to downstream logging.
findings.regression_test: Reject failed exits, malformed CPU and missing memory while preserving valid zero and ordinary samples.

findings.title: Download JavaScript execution errors are invisible
findings.reproduction: Make evaluateJavaScript throw during initial queue delivery and set_detail: both evaluations fail with zero diagnostic errors.
findings.root_cause: Execution discards protected-call results and omits the native asynchronous error callback.
findings.silent_failure: The process continues while the progress UI stops reflecting its state.
findings.regression_test: Exercise immediate, navigation and fallback delivery with native throws, asynchronous errors and success; preserve session identity and redact payloads.

findings.title: Pre-ready log bursts evict required window initialization
findings.reproduction: Show an installation window, append 201 log lines before navigation completes, then flush: setKind is absent from all 200 delivered commands.
findings.root_cause: One bounded FIFO mixes indispensable state updates and disposable log history.
findings.silent_failure: Overflow removes initialization without a diagnostic or recovery path.
findings.regression_test: Retain required initialization and latest state across log overflow while bounding retained log history and reporting dropped counts.

findings.title: Reusing an unready window hides its cancel button
findings.reproduction: Show A and then B before first navigation: resetUI runs before translated labels arrive, hiding and disabling Cancel.
findings.root_cause: Native-window reuse is mistaken for reuse of an already initialized document.
findings.silent_failure: Existing reuse tests complete navigation before replacing the operation.
findings.regression_test: Replace an operation before first readiness without resetting the untouched document, while preserving reset for initialized reuse.

findings.title: Bootstrap Terminal log paths are not shell quoted
findings.reproduction: Open bootstrap Terminal with a unified log under a user directory containing spaces: tail receives multiple path arguments instead of the intended log.
findings.root_cause: The path is concatenated into a shell command before AppleScript escaping, which does not provide shell quoting.
findings.silent_failure: osascript can launch Terminal successfully even though its tail command fails.
findings.regression_test: Preserve spaces, apostrophes and shell metacharacters as one literal path argument, while leaving complete caller-supplied commands unchanged.

findings.title: Delayed frontend actions cancel a replacement operation in the same window
findings.reproduction: Retain the actual shared frontend's cancel body for A, show B in the same native window, then deliver A's body: B is cancelled and A is not.
findings.root_cause: Plain string bridge messages carry no operation identity, so native window identity cannot distinguish occupants.
findings.silent_failure: The same usercontent controller remains current across reuse and delivers stale intent to current callbacks.
findings.regression_test: Tag Hammerspoon operations end-to-end and reject predecessor actions while preserving the legacy message contract for other drivers.
